environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7 application deployed on EKS behind an AWS ALB with target group routing. ALB is configured with a standard HTTPS listener (ACM certificate) forwarding to port 8080. No client certificate validation is configured on the ALB listener. The service is exposed via a public-facing ALB DNS name accessible to any HTTP client. Thymeleaf 3.0.15 with SpringEL enabled (default). No network policies restrict ingress to the pod.
